image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a transparent plastic audio cassette tape resting on a white surface. The cassette contains a pink paper label with handwritten text and visible internal spools with brown magnetic tape. The plastic casing shows reflections and molded structural details.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small rectangular plastic enclosure fitting comfortably in palm with thickness much smaller than width or height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object exhibits the characteristic flat, rectangular prism shape of a cassette with appropriate aspect ratio and rounded corners.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two circular holes revealing tape spools inside.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct circular apertures are clearly visible, revealing the internal spool mechanisms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two spools of magnetic tape visible through circular holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Dark circular spools with wound brown magnetic tape are clearly visible through the transparent casing holes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular opening at bottom exposing tape for player head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The standard rectangular slot at the bottom edge of the cassette face is visible, consistent with player head access.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface has molded details screw holes tape guide slots and write-protect tabs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Molded plastic details, including screw holes (bottom left/right) and internal tape guides, are visible through the clear casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Casing transparent or opaque plastic typically black gray or clear.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casing is clearly transparent plastic, allowing visibility of internal components, matching the 'clear' variant description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label area on one face displaying track information artist and title.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A pink paper label is inserted into the J-card slot, featuring handwritten text that mimics track/artist information.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Visible internal spools through transparent casing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The transparency of the shell allows full view of the internal spools and tape path.

artifact_observations.location: Pink label on the cassette face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text on the pink label is illegible and structurally inconsistent, resembling AI-generated pseudo-handwriting rather than coherent characters. While this mimics bad handwriting, the letter forms lack logical construction.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the transparent casing
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight inconsistency in the refraction/reflection logic of the plastic ribs on the right side; some edges appear slightly soft or fused compared to the crisp molding on the left.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular plastic object.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the handwritten text on the pink label, checking for AI text artifacts.
To verify the structural integrity of the transparent plastic shell and ensure no melting or fusion errors in the complex molded details.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on the label
Structural correctness of internal spools and tape path
Refraction and reflection consistency in transparent plastic casing
Sharpness of molded details (screw holes, guides)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the pink label. Is it genuinely illegible handwriting or AI gibberish? Check if the internal spools connect logically to the tape path. Verify if the reflections on the plastic casing are physically consistent with a single light source.
